title: PracticePay Patient Financing Late-Fee Relief: When It Is Owed and How Much
content:
## 1. The late fee considered

The late fee considered is the plan's latest late-fee entry by assessment date, the one recorded first where two share that date, and its due date is the installment due date it names.

## 2. Made up and cleared

That monthly payment has been made up after the fee when the plan's next due date, its oldest unpaid due date, is later than that due date and the latest payment entry credited toward that due date, the one recorded first where two share that date, is dated after the fee's assessment date and has not come back, no returned-payment entry naming it; that latest payment's date is the make-up date, and the make-up has cleared once 3 calendar days have passed since the make-up date.

## 3. When a relief is owed

A late-fee relief is owed only when the make-up has cleared, today is no later than the fee waiver request window after the fee's assessment date, fewer than the plan's courtesy waivers per 12 months have been granted on the plan within the last 12 months, and the fee carries no waiver entry yet; otherwise nothing is relieved. The courtesy waivers granted within the last 12 months are those dated fewer than 12 whole months before the relief date, a month being whole once the relief date's day of the month has reached the entry's day of the month. The request window and the courtesy-waiver number are the per-plan figures of the PracticePay Patient Financing fee schedule.

## 4. Amount

The late-fee relief is the late fee in full, rounded half up to the nearest cent. Where a rule of the late-fee relief schedule sets a relief size or a share, the relief size takes the place of the full fee, every share multiplies it, all shares applying together, the product is never more than the part of the fee not already waived, and it is rounded half up to the nearest cent once, at the end. A late-fee relief that works out to 0.00 is not owed, and nothing is booked for it.

## Worked case (hypothetical plan, relief date 20 May)

| Item | Record | Judgement |
|---|---|---|
| Latest late fee | 30.00 USD, assessed 1 May, for the 20 April due date | the fee considered |
| Next due date | 20 May, later than 20 April | first condition met |
| Latest payment toward 20 April | dated 12 May, not come back | made up after the fee; make-up date 12 May |
| Cleared | 8 days have passed since 12 May, at least 3 | cleared |
| Request window | 19 days after 1 May | within a 45-day window |
| Courtesy waivers in the last 12 months | none | fewer than 1 |
| Waiver entries on the fee | none | no waiver yet |
| Relief | the fee in full | 30.00 USD |

Had the 12 May payment been dated 18 May, only 2 days would have passed on 20 May and the make-up would not yet have cleared: nothing is relieved that day.
